title: Recording: Gypsies In Flight by Ringo Starr | 1977
content:
Atlantic Studios, New York City
Producer: Arif Mardin
Engineer: Lew Hahn

Ringo Starr began recording ‘Gypsies In Flight’ for his sixth studio album, Ringo The 4th, on 28 January 1977.

Although predominantly a disco album, Ringo The 4th contained diversions into other styles. ‘Gypsies In Flight’ harked back to Starr’s second solo album, the country and western Beaucoups Of Blues. It was written by Starr and Vini Poncia, one of six such collaborations on the album.
